award.description: Lockheed Martin Aeronautics Co., Fort Worth, Texas, is awarded a $114,629,966 cost-plus-fixed-fee order (N0001927F1037) against a previously issued basic ordering agreement (N0001924G0010). This order provides nonrecurring engineering, redesign, integration, qualification, and testing for two F-35 Lightning II navigation systems: the Global Positioning System Electronic Unit and the NAV100 Inertial Navigation System. The effort will replace obsolete electronic components while maintaining system performance and compatibility with existing aircraft systems. These redesigns are intended to prevent production disruptions, address diminishing manufacturing sources, and support the continued production and sustainment of F-35 aircraft for the Air Force, Navy, Marine Corps, and F-35 cooperative program partners. Work will be performed in El Segundo, California (70.1%); Fort Worth, Texas (27.5%); and Clearwater, Florida (2.4%), and is expected to be completed in January 2030. Fiscal 2026 aircraft procurement (Air Force) funds in the amount of $46,411,323; fiscal 2026 aircraft procurement (Navy) funds in the amount of $46,411,322; and F-35 cooperative program partner funds in the amount of $21,807,321, will be obligated at the time of award. This order was not competitively procured. Naval Air Systems Command, Patuxent River, Maryland, is the contracting activity.
